name: BTQ Testnet v0.3.0
summary: BTQ testnet v0.3.0 is the first operational implementation of BIP-360 (P2MR). It introduces 5 Dilithium post-quantum signature opcodes, SegWit v2 (bc1z) addresses, 64 MiB blocks, restored SegWit discount, and end-to-end CLI wallet tools.
summaryZh: BTQ 测试网 v0.3.0 是 BIP-360（P2MR）的首个 operational 实现。引入 5 个 Dilithium 后量子签名操作码、SegWit v2（bc1z）地址、64 MiB 区块、恢复 SegWit 折扣和端到端 CLI 钱包工具。
